source.title: Lenya - Wild Cyclone
source.name: Lenya
source.description: An agile Rogue who excels in duels against the most powerful enemy.

skills.name: Wild Duel

description.raw: Lenya targets the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage and dashes at them, delivering a flying kick that deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and knocks them back in a straight line toward an open area. She then follows up with a second flying kick, dealing 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage, before initiating a duel with that enemy. The duel lasts for 12s, during which both Lenya and the enemy prioritize attacking each other. Lenya's flying kick can stun the enemy for 2 seconds, and she is Unaffected while performing the kicks.

skills.name: Tornado Strike

description.raw: Passive. Lenya blocks a normal attack from her current target if the target is within 1 tile. She then retaliates with a kick that deals 260% (ATK-based) + 25% (SP-based) damage and stuns the target for 2s. The effect can be triggered once every 6s and makes Lenya Unaffected while active. Active. Lenya performs a tornado kick, dealing 110% (ATK-based) damage 3 times to surrounding enemies.

skills.name: Winning Resolve

description.raw: Lenya unlocks her full potential once a duel begins, increasing her Crit DMG Boost by 55 and ATK by 15% during the duel. While at full potential, her Flurry Kicks skill delivers a super kick instead of a power kick, dealing 70% (ATK-based) damage 8 times and stunning the enemy for 2s.
